## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `48b24db8e3682be7b81776e5ab5fa87a706d2ec7` · 2026-11-24T19:58Z

Requested by zone a4-C (7142451523) for card #36737.

Delivered and correct, read against the code: in design mode the record tab row is the tabs editor, staged under `record-tabs:OBJECT`, saved by the mode's Save through the unchanged `saveRecordTabs` (own package and installed `.custom`) and dropped by its Cancel; `RecordTabsConfigBar` and the ⋯ entry are gone with their gates kept; a failed save keeps the draft with the mode's own error; the region's accessible name moved onto the editor. The list draft buttons read 重置 / 更新视图 by changing two existing keys' values in all eleven packs (key set unchanged, so `@object-ui/i18n` publishes no surface change; `@object-ui/app-shell` is private) and stay live in design mode, pinned. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch: right. Tests run through the real controller, bar and record view and fail on the base. Check-runs: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed.

The zone's four points: (1) 「另存为我的视图」 is the unchanged base label and is pinned — fine; (2) keep the three dead `designMode.recordTabs.*` keys — removing them would narrow the published pack; (3) the 119-file local run is acceptable, CI ran the full UI suite green; (4) the early WIP push is a process deviation with no product effect — the merge into current main is clean.

S1 (should-fix) — `ListDraftActions.tsx` (the update button and its menu, ~:104 and :132-176): the button reads 「更新视图 / Update view」 even when no save-to-view is offered and its menu holds only 「另存为我的视图」 — the common case for shipped views (the dev's own showcase check hit it). The label promises an action that is not there. Fix: when no save-to-view is offered, the button carries the `saveAsMyView` text; pin both cases (save offered / not offered); ablate the branch.
S2 (should-fix) — the card's acceptance asks for browser screenshots; the dev's four sit at a path outside the PR and are not attached. Attach them to the PR body (Setup / record page in design mode with the tab editor, the list buttons in both states after S1), and one at 375 px for the phone chip row (N4).

Nits (fix while there): N1 comments and one test name still say Discard / Save or "edit state" (`ListDraftActions.tsx` ~:132, :159-160; `ListDraftActions.noSave-35955.test.tsx`:16; `RecordDetailView.tsx` ~:6456); N2 re-add "re-show a tab hidden by default" to the mode's Cancel test; N3 the tab editor now shows alongside an open whole-record edit form where the old ⋯ entry was hidden — gate it, or state in the PR body that it is intended; N5 optional pin: a failed tabs save keeps the editor on the draft with the mode on. N6 (the mode draws the default tab order while on) is disclosed in the body — accepted.

Landing K: 26 since the merge base — merge `main` in the rework round. Delta L1 on the new head.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [45495324486](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45495324486) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45495324486/job/138804475183)** — 失败步骤: Boot example apps and exercise real user flows

  ```
  @objectstack/dogfood:test:  FAIL   isolated  test/wall-package-refusal.dogfood.test.ts > [ADR-0131 D3 · #15204 W2] group: a catalog-carrying package is the platform operator's > CONTROL: the platform 
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/dogfood:test: Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `test/wall-package-refusal.dogfood.test.ts` — 24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过，暂不汇总（再有一个不同 PR 撞到就会自动开汇总 issue）。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 2 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
